title: mpeg table: add IDs for EIT schedule tables (0x50 - 0x6F)
description:
Add and name all the DVB (MPEG) EIT table IDs. 
0x4E, 0x4F - present/following and actual and other accordingly.
0x50...0x5F - schedules for an actual transport stream.
0x60...0x6F - schedules for another transport stream.
